platform_resolution: platforminfo -l or PLATFORM_REPO_PATHS; no absolute path is embedded

release300.purpose: paper target request; requires non-negative routed WNS/WHS and achieved-clock evidence

known_limitations: The four top kernels expose one gmem0 AXI master, not a validated 32-channel HBM co-design.
phase_events is AXI-Stream and needs a U55C-compatible consumer or a revised measured-counter contract before v++ link.
No routed image, XRT host, achieved clock, resource report or board latency is included in this HLS-only release.
ResNet P2GN16 requires a separate production operand/payload/address/runtime contract and is not covered by the P1 primitive kernels.
